tools.name: nhtsa_decode_vin
tools.description: Decode a 17-character Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) using NHTSA vPIC: make, model, model year, trim, body class, engine, fuel type, drive type, manufacturing plant, standard safety equipment, and an overview of matching NHTSA recalls.

tools.name: nhtsa_vehicle_recalls
tools.description: Fetch official NHTSA safety recalls for a vehicle by 17-character VIN or make, model, and model_year. Returns recall count, urgent Park-It (Do Not Drive), Park-Outside, and Over-The-Air update flags, campaign numbers, components, summaries, consequences, and remedies.

tools.name: nhtsa_safety_complaints
tools.description: Fetch and aggregate official NHTSA consumer safety complaints for a vehicle by VIN or make, model, and model_year. Returns total complaints, crash/fire/injury/death counts, top complained-about components, and recent complaint summaries (optionally filtered by component keyword).

tools.name: nhtsa_safety_ratings
tools.description: Fetch official NHTSA 5-Star NCAP crash-test safety ratings by VIN or make, model, and model_year: overall stars, front crash, side crash, side pole, rollover stars and rollover risk %, standard crash-avoidance tech (ESC, FCW, LDW), and recall/complaint/investigation counts per trim variant.
